title: HandLive — sms/send (C→S, ack)
description: SMS-04 API 1. Android acks as soon as its checks pass, before the radio sends; progress follows as sms/status. The success ack carries {accepted, parts}: #/$defs/ack.

local_id.description: Temporary ID generated by the client; Android's deduplication key.

thread_id.description: The conversation being written in; recorded only.

body.description: Not empty or whitespace only; at most SMS_BODY_MAX = 1,600 characters.

sub_id.description: Sending SIM; absent → the phone's default SMS SIM.

ack.description: Success ack of sms/send. Error acks use ack.schema.json#/$defs/failure (FEATURE_DISABLED, PERMISSION_MISSING, BAD_REQUEST, PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, SMS_INVALID_ADDRESS, SMS_SIM_UNAVAILABLE).
